verdict.rationale: Fern's docs show it collects reader feedback, search queries, unanswered Ask Fern questions, and analytics. It has a Web Analytics tab, and llms.txt traffic is broken down by LLM provider. Most of this appears only indirectly, in changelog text about automations and the MCP server, rather than in a dedicated analytics dashboard doc. missing for 10: explicit documentation of human page-view metrics, a search-terms report and a reader-feedback UI (e.g., thumbs/ratings per page), plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I see page views, search terms, and reader feedback so I know which docs work and which fail

citations.quote: Automations can review your reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, search queries, or analytics, report back what it found
Track usage in the [Web Analytics tab]
The tab reports `llms.txt` usage including: Traffic by LLM provider (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.)
to read your sites, deployments, and reader activity without leaving your terminal
